drift.evidence: Four source-timestamped rates with an 800-sample ramp are measured to an exact target length.

duration.evidence: Target output length is the rounded cumulative source-to-output map; measured error is recorded per case.

final_partial_window.evidence: A 12485-sample non-frame-aligned clip records the final partial input and output window counts.

identity_1x.evidence: The identity case is an exact sample passthrough with unit rate and zero duration error.

music.evidence: A generated three-tone music surrogate is used; no music recording or rights-cleared material is present.

pause_filler_source_timestamps.evidence: Protect/flex labels are frozen at source samples and never use wall time or playback position; they are synthetic metadata.

pitch.evidence: Autocorrelation pitch proxy on synthetic stationary tones; listening is deferred and non-tonal cases withhold pitch.

playback_buffering.evidence: Caller-owned FIFO checkpoints in source samples and nanoseconds; no device pacing or fill/flush measurement exists.

rate_changes.evidence: Constant faster/slower cases and a four-segment drift schedule are measured, including an unsmoothed step adverse control.

rebuffer.evidence: A source-timestamped synthetic pause records a 1600-sample playback deficit with no fabricated compensation.

silence.evidence: An all-zero synthetic clip is processed; pitch is explicitly withheld rather than imputed.

source_output_mapping.evidence: Every case records monotone output centers, native source windows, a mapping digest and terminal-window flags; no DIRAC or ZTX output exists.

speech_preservation.evidence: Mapped RMS of protected synthetic speech intervals is reported; intelligibility and listening remain blocked.

transient_audibility.evidence: Synthetic click peak and threshold-crossing width are compared with an identity control; this is not listening.

unfamiliar_speech.evidence: A generated voiced/mixed speech surrogate is used; it is not a recording, corpus item or unfamiliar speaker.

candidate.finding: Legacy DIRAC binaries are separate artifacts with unverified terms; contemporary Zynaptiq ZTX is commercial closed source. No licensed artifact, evaluation kit, headers, exact API geometry, SIG/SLA, price or local run exists.

vendor_reported.legacy_dirac: legacy name for the DSP Dimension technology; old free binaries should not be adopted without checking their terms
vendor_reported.ztx_le: free-to-use with one signed SLA per product; limited to one channel at 44.1/48 kHz and no dynamic stretch/pitch changes
vendor_reported.ztx_pro: any rate, unlimited channels and dynamic parameter changes
vendor_reported.ztx_studio: two channels, 8-96 kHz, no dynamic parameter changes

exact_blockers.requirement: Exact licensed legacy DIRAC artifact: vendor, product/version, platform and architecture, immutable binary SHA-256, packaged evaluation kit and local install record.
Contemporary Zynaptiq ZTX comparator: approved procurement path, tier (STUDIO/PRO), quote or evaluation grant, version and immutable SDK/archive SHA-256.
Exact callable API: headers, symbol/ABI list, sample rate and channel limits, block/seek geometry, dynamic-rate semantics, content delay and final-partial behavior.
Executed license/SLA and rights review: redistribution, product use, derivative output, attribution/notice, patent indemnity and per-product signed SLA where required.
Rights-cleared, task-matched unfamiliar speech and music cohort with authorized listening, intelligibility and transient scoring.
Exact candidate numeric output: frozen vendor renders for 1x, faster/slower, drift, rebuffer and final partial cases, with byte-level parity to the proposal boundary.
Target-device pacing, availability, buffers, CPU, memory, power and deadline evidence at the exact runtime and load.
Opt-in provider intake, descriptor/registry decision, independent exact-head review and default/release approval.

external_artifacts.note: No DIRAC or ZTX artifact, license, SLA, evaluation kit, recording or corpus is staged in this package.

licensing.reported_upstream_license: commercial closed source; ZTX LE free-to-use under a signed per-product SLA; STUDIO/PRO licensed (source-reported only)

negative_claims: No legacy DIRAC binary, Zynaptiq ZTX SDK, evaluation kit, header, library, installer or license/SLA is present, copied, downloaded, loaded, imported or executed.
No real speech, music, recording, corpus, consent, listening, quality, intelligibility or device result exists.
No DIRAC or ZTX duration, latency, pitch, transient, buffering, throughput or quality value is claimed; every measured value belongs to the deterministic task-local surrogate on synthetic clips.
No candidate sample rate, channel limit, block size, dynamic-rate semantics, content delay, output geometry or final-partial behavior is locally verified.
No installed v0, public API/ABI, descriptor, registry, default, shared build, CI, board, handoff or other worktree change is made.
No processor exposure, adapter registration, benchmark entry or release qualification is produced.
No device timing, pacing, buffer occupancy, CPU, power or hard real-time claim is made.

reference.note: An original native-grain OLA probe, not DIRAC and not ZTX, not derived from vendor code and unable to qualify either candidate.

release_gates.requirement: Pin the exact licensed legacy DIRAC artifact and the approved ZTX STUDIO/PRO comparator with immutable vendor/version/platform identity, archive or binary SHA-256 and license/SLA references.
Admit the runtime in an isolated hash-pinned artifact tree, reproduce installation and verify identity with fail-closed absent behavior and no default-package bytes.
Clear license, SLA, redistribution, product-use, derivative-output, attribution/notice and patent-indemnity terms for the exact artifact and tier.
Map exact sample rate/channel/block geometry, dynamic-rate semantics, content delay and final partial behavior into the installed 16 kHz mono float32 160-sample boundary with parity.
Qualify the rate profile on rights-cleared unfamiliar speech and music with authorized listening, pitch, transient, duration and speech-preservation scoring.
Measure candidate state, reset, dynamic rate changes, nonfinite and peak bounds, rebuffer/drift recovery and availability at the exact runtime.
Measure target-device playback pacing, fill/flush, buffer occupancy, CPU, memory, power and deadlines under the intended workload.
Complete opt-in provider intake, descriptor/registry review, independent exact-head review and default/release approval.

reopen_condition: Obtain the exact licensed legacy DIRAC artifact and an approved Zynaptiq ZTX STUDIO/PRO evaluation or license, with immutable vendor/version/platform identity, archive SHA-256 and executed SLA; admit the runtime in an isolated artifact tree; clear license, redistribution, product-use, derivative-output and patent terms; map exact rate/channel/block/dynamic-rate/content-delay geometry into the installed mono boundary with parity; qualify on rights-cleared unfamiliar speech and music with authorized listening; measure target-device pacing and resources; and complete opt-in provider intake and independent review. Until every condition is closed both candidates stay DEFER, incomplete and not qualified.
